messages:
sophie (producer): Recording and rough edit for KestrelCloud advocate is uploaded: https://files.redwood/kestrel-advocate-v2.mp4. Need: legal on the quote, product sign-off on the technical callouts, and final scheduling for press embargo. Proposed embargo: 2025-05-03 09:00 PT. Transcript excerpt below.

marta (prod-marketing): Got it — thanks Sophie. I'm +1 on the embargo date, aligns with content calendar. Can you paste the one-sentence customer quote you want in the hero? We should shrink it if it's long.

sophie (producer): Quote candidate A: "KestrelCloud cut inference costs 3.4x with Redwood Dedicated while improving tail latency — the migration was seamless."

ben (legal): Heads-up: please remove comparatives like "improving tail latency" unless we have metric lineage in the doc. Also swap "3.4x" for "~3x" unless finance signs off on the exact number. Send the raw timing logs if you're keeping the metric. :eyes:

sophie (producer): Copy — attaching the raw perf CSV and the edit notes.

publish-bot: upload complete: kestrel-advocate-v2.mp4 (size: 238MB)

marta (prod-marketing): For marketing: prefer a short hero quote. Alternate condensed: "Redwood Dedicated cut our inference costs ~3x and made performance predictable." That reads tighter. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

sam (sales-ops): One ops ask: when live, route inbound interest from the Kestrel page to SDR queue "SDR-Kestrel" and tag with source=advocate-kestrel. We can use the existing webhook — sample curl below.

sam (sales-ops): ```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/sdr-route \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"lead_email":"{{email}}","source":"advocate-kestrel","queue":"SDR-Kestrel"}'
```

jaz (growth): I can build the landing and add the UTM params. Quick Q: do we want a webinar follow-up? I think a short 30-min "how they migrated" session would drive MQLs. Propose two weeks after embargo: 2025-05-17, 11am PT.

marta (prod-marketing): Webinar sounds good. Sophie — can you confirm speakers list (Kestrel PM, Kestrel Eng lead, Redwood Solutions Eng)? Also need a 1-pager for CS to prep the tech demo.

sophie (producer): Confirmed speakers as suggested. I'll draft a 1-pager by EOD Wednesday.

ben (legal): On the quote: redlined version for hero: "Redwood Dedicated reduced our inference costs ~3x and made performance more predictable." Ben, Legal (approved with redline). If marketing insists on exact number, we need signoff from finance and the dataset backing the number.

marta (prod-marketing): Accepted redline. We'll use that hero quote and note the detailed metric in the blog footnote with a link to the benchmark appendix.

sam (sales-ops): Routing note: once the lead webhook is live, set a simple automation: if lead.source=="advocate-kestrel" tag campaign=kestrel-cs-2025 and notify SDR slack channel #sdr-kestrel. I can deploy the automation.

sophie (producer): Timeline check:
- Legal approval on final asset + quote: by 2025-04-30
- Product & Kestrel sign-off on edits: by 2025-04-30
- Landing & webinar page ready: by 2025-05-01
- Embargo: 2025-05-03 09:00 PT
- Webinar: 2025-05-17 11:00 PT
If any blockers, flag ASAP.

ben (legal): I'll do the formal approval email once I get the final transcript and raw perf logs.

jaz (growth): I'll scaffold the landing and mock the webinar RSVP flow. Sam, can you confirm the webhook endpoint is stable for 5/03?

sam (sales-ops): Endpoint is stable. I'll add a smoke test and post a test lead to #sdr-kestrel on 5/01.

marta (prod-marketing): Small brand check — no use of competitor names or logos in the case study. Sophie, please remove the one line where the customer references another vendor.

sophie (producer): Will redact that line from the transcript and from the caption. Updated cut uploaded as kestrel-advocate-v2-edit.mp4.

publish-bot: upload complete: kestrel-advocate-v2-edit.mp4 (size: 192MB)

marta (prod-marketing): Everything sounds in order. Ben, ping when legal posts the approval. Sophie, ping me when 1-pager is done so I can write the landing copy.

ben (legal): Approved pending the raw perf CSV attached to the approval email. I'll send the email now.

sophie (producer): Thanks — attaching CSV in thread. Linking to the final assets here: https://files.redwood/kestrel-final-package.zip.

marta (prod-marketing): :partyparrot: Nice work team. I'll slot the post for 5/03 09:00 PT and calendar the webinar for 5/17.

jaz (growth): I'll post a draft hero and CTA in #design-requests for quick review.

sam (sales-ops): I'll schedule the webhook smoke test for 2025-05-01 09:30 PT and notify #sdr-kestrel.

sophie (producer): Closing checklist: legal ok, product ok, assets uploaded, landing & RSVP flow in progress. Will update if anything changes.

marta (prod-marketing): Closing note — please keep internal embargo hush: only people copied on approval email should talk about this until 5/03. :zipper_mouth_face:

ben (legal): Approved email sent to stakeholders. :white_check_mark:

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks all. End of thread."
